title: machine-read-object-list
description: NX-062 M4a (ADR-041 amendment A1): the answer of POST /machine/v1/read with verb object.list - one page (at most 50) of a type's objects of the key's world, in object id order; an object the key may not see is left out and never counted - there is no total and no hidden count (L6 N2), so a page may hold fewer items than it scanned; next_after is the cursor of the next page (params.after) or null. Only metadata and the properties registered for the object's type in the verb's projection (control.nexloop_machine_read_verbs), applied in SQL (authz.nexloop_machine_read): never a free text, a message reference, an external order id, a contact or an internal executor; a value naming a Consumer being erased is left out; an owner-restricted property group is never returned. Machine reads are open for Commitment and CommercialRecord only. Tenant, world and actor come from the key. NexLoop target contract; server-derived identity required.
